text: ABU SHALL NEVER RETURN ME TO THE JUDGMENT OF ZAN, THE OLD MYSTIC!" THIS HAD BEEN THE UNSPOKEN DEFIANCE OF BLACK LANGA, EVIL SORCERESS OF THE TEMPLE OF APES AND NOW, AS THE JUNGLE WIZARD POLES A NATIVE DUGOUT TOWARD THE CLIFF-TOP CAVE OF MAGICAL ZAN...

...LANGA'S LIPS CURVE INTO A
CRUEL SMILE-FOR SHE KNOWS
THAT HER FRIENDS, THE SHUNNED
TRIBE OF N'KAO, WORSHIPERS AT
THE DARK IDOL OF MU,HAVE NOT
BEEN IDLE...

THE NEXT CURVE OF
THE RIVER SHALL SEE
THE FINISH OF TABU...
FOR MY THOUGHT
SENSES TELL ME
THAT THE N'KAO
WAIT THERE TO
FREE ME!

WHAT DO YOU SMILE AT
EVIL WITCH... THINK YOU TO
ESCAPE ZAN'S JUSTICE?WAH
HAD I NOT SWORN TO DELIVER
YOU UNHARMED, I WOULD... BUT,
NO-MY TEMPER SWAYS ME!
THE VENGEANCE IS ZANS!

NO, JUNGLE WIZARD-
JUNGLE FOOL! THE
VENGEANCE SHALL BE
MINE, FOR YOUR
INSOLENCE AND SOON...
FOR WE ROUND THE
BEND-AND I SENSE
THAT THE NIKAO
ARE VERY NEAR!
